page.layout: Two circular medallion portraits side by side at top, with their inscriptions; below them one column of running text in two paragraphs. Page number and running head at top. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: MAXIMILIANVS secundus Iunior Austrius Ferdinandi filius,à rege Boëmiæ,Frácfortdiæ Rex Romanorũ Cæsarque octauo Kalendas Decembris,1562. creatus fuit,ibidémque coronatus, regnauit cum patre Ferdinando, per anni spatiũ & octo mesiũ:quo tępore,ordo militiæ S.Stephani Papæ in Insula Iluæ,à Cosmo Medice Florentinorum Duce institutus, à Pio 4. pontifice maximo cõfirmatur, & bella plusquam hostilia in regno Galliarũ,ob religionẽ excitata, Ducis Guisij viri præclarissimi,acerba catholicis cæde, sedantur.Hic tanto amore non solũ à suis sed etiã ab omnibus est ( non immerito ) profecutus, ut humani generis amor & delitiæ, appellatus fit. Imperauit post patris obitũ,annos plures,tanta cum moderatione & iustitia,ut erepti mortem omnes sui ægrè tulerint & defleuerint diù. Huius filia prudentissima Elisabetha collocata est in matrimonium Carolo nono Francorũ Regi,qui filiam ex ea fuscepit,quę paulo post eius obitum,& matris apud suos reditum,mortua est.

MARIA Caroli v. filia,Maximiliani ii. Romanorum Imperatoris defuncti uxor,Ferdinandi nurus: & Philippi, Hispaniarum Regis foror, ea pignora suis tradidit, quæ summorum, summæque familiæ principum nomina illis renouarent, idque viuens ipsa vidit, quod in maxima fœlicitatis parte omnes locandum putant, filias duas summis orbis terrarum Regibus in matrimonium collocatas. Hæc maxima sunt, quæque nescio an unquam contigerint: sed maiora illa, quæ ipsi propria sunt, Pietas in Deũ, charitas, qua tenuiores assiduè subleuat, & præcipuum studium catholicæ religionis: quæ posteritas non silebit ulla.

page.notes: Medallion inscriptions are set in capitals around the portraits; the right-hand medallion's right-hand inscription is only partly legible and is marked [?]. Printed "Frácfortdiæ" and "ibidémque" carry an accent as printed. "Caroli v." and "Maximiliani ii." are printed with lower-case roman numerals; kept as printed. The paragraph text is set in a slightly blurred impression; words marked by reading are not otherwise doubtful.
